project: PROJECT 3F: NQ P90-Armed Reversal Micro-Transition Study

key_findings.timing_of_extreme: The final prevailing extreme is established predominantly at T-3s to T-1s before T0 (peaking at T-2s).
key_findings.earliest_rejection_onset: Rejection first becomes causally visible at T-2s with high-wick formation and deceleration.
key_findings.divergence_from_false_pauses: TRUE reversals diverge statistically from FALSE pauses between T-2s and T0, primarily via prevailing deceleration and fade bar close location.
